# pagination API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Controlled offset, cursor and load-more requests with application-owned data.

## Pagination

Request page, cursor or incremental navigation using native Fluent buttons.
Requires shared Fluent theme/renderer peers, with no SPFx provider. The consumer
owns results, page resets, a readable result summary, error handling and pending locks.
Stale known-total indices are not clamped: first/previous allow recovery, while
next/last are unavailable. Empty results at index zero disable every page action.
Loading progress replaces the last activated icon. Without a prior action it
appears in next (pages/cursor), or the single load-more action, keeping labels visible.

### Imports

```ts
import { Pagination } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Pagination } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { Pagination } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pagination';
```

### Use when

- The application owns page data and needs controlled offset, cursor or load-more request controls.

### Avoid when

- The widget must fetch or slice data or store cursor tokens itself; those responsibilities belong in the consumer.

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Pagination } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const hasMore = true;
const loadingMore = false;
async function loadMore(): Promise<void> { console.log('Next batch requested'); }
function reportError(error: unknown): void { console.error(error); }
<Pagination pagination={{ type: 'loadMore', hasNextPage: hasMore }} loading={loadingMore}
  onPaginationChange={() => { void loadMore().catch(reportError); }} />
```

## PaginationChangeData

Request intent; the consumer commits the next state and handles asynchronous failures.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { PaginationChangeData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { PaginationChangeData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { PaginationChangeData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pagination';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import { PaginationChangeData } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function requestedPage(data: PaginationChangeData): number | undefined {
  return data.type === 'pages' ? data.pageIndex : undefined;
}
```

### Type

```ts
type PaginationChangeData = | {
      /**
       * Requests an offset page.
       */
      readonly type: 'pages';
      /**
       * Requested zero-based page index.
       */
      readonly pageIndex: number;
      /**
       * Unchanged page size from the supplied state.
       */
      readonly pageSize: number;
    }
  | {
      /**
       * Requests cursor navigation.
       */
      readonly type: 'cursor';
      /**
       * Requested direction; no cursor token is exposed.
       */
      readonly direction: 'previous' | 'next';
    }
  | {
      /**
       * Requests an incremental append.
       */
      readonly type: 'loadMore';
    }
```

## PaginationProps

Controlled navigation composed with consumer-owned results and their status summary.
Uses the host Fluent theme/Griffel renderer without an SPFx provider.
Invalid runtime state renders no landmark or controls. Native nav attributes and
consumer-provided style are forwarded; children and raw HTML are not supported.

### Imports (7)

```ts
import type { PaginationProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { PaginationProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { PaginationProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pagination';
```

### Examples (7)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Pagination } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
export function PageNavigation(): React.ReactElement {
  const [pageIndex, setPageIndex] = React.useState(0);
  return <Pagination pagination={{ type: 'pages', pageIndex, pageSize: 10, totalItems: 42 }}
  onPaginationChange={(_event, data) => { if (data.type === 'pages') setPageIndex(data.pageIndex); }} />;
}
```

### Type (2)

```ts
type PaginationProps = Omit<React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'nav'>, 'children' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML'> & {
  /**
   * Application-owned state; use safe integer indices, sizes and totals.
   */
  readonly pagination: PaginationState;
  /**
   * Called for an available action with its React event and discriminated navigation
   * request. Loading and already-prevented events suppress requests. When omitted, leaves actions
   * visible without committing navigation. The component never updates page state or awaits
   * returned promises; the consumer handles fetching, pending locks and failures.
   * @param data - Discriminated requested offset page, cursor direction or load-more intent; update application state externally.
   * @param event - React event for the available navigation action.
   */
  readonly onPaginationChange?: (event: React.SyntheticEvent, data: PaginationChangeData) => void;
  /**
   * Disables actions and shows labelled progress. When omitted, defaults to false. The consumer locks pending requests.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  readonly loading?: boolean;
  /**
   * Button density. When omitted, defaults to medium.
   * @defaultValue 'medium'
   */
  readonly size?: PaginationSize;
  /**
   * Native Fluent Button appearance for every navigation action, including Load more. When omitted, defaults to subtle.
   * @defaultValue 'subtle'
   */
  readonly appearance?: ButtonProps['appearance'];
  /**
   * Partial localized labels. Missing, blank or undefined values use the host-selected native resource. Supplied values are trimmed.
   */
  readonly strings?: Partial<PaginationStrings>;
}
```

## PaginationStrings

Visible and accessible labels for all navigation modes. Supply a partial object through
`PaginationProps.strings`; missing/undefined/blank entries fall back to the host-selected native resource and
supplied values are trimmed. SPFx selects the UI resource independently of controlled data.

### Imports (10)
